sam: Quick sync — we need to finalize prioritization and launch gates for the smart routing fallback work. Two inbound asks: Customer A requires strict regional affinity SLA; Customer B wants an opt-in lowest-cost fallback that may increase latency. How do we reconcile?

alex: Map asks to launch gates. My take: regional affinity = GA must-have for Dedicated/Private. cost-first fallback = beta opt-in.

jordan: Agreed on opt-in. Major engineering risk is quality regressions when falling back to quantized variants. We need a compatibility check before switching.

maria: FYI: some 4-bit quant variants fail function-calling in our integration tests. If we swap mid-request, function outputs can diverge. Streaming + KV cache mix is another risky path.

nina: SE asks for clear config surface. Proposal: routing.policy = [latency_first, cost_first, regional_affinity]; fallback.strict_compat = true|false; allowed_variants = [list] for tenant.

alex: Draft acceptance criteria: 1) PRD enumerates each policy behavior and measurable SLO impact (p95 latency, cost delta). 2) Compatibility gating: any fallback must pass automated compat checks (tokenizer, function call, output schema). 3) Tests: unit + e2e that simulate mid-stream fallback and validate output parity within tolerance. 4) Docs + example configs + migration notes.

sam: Also decide scope by product tier: regional_affinity = Dedicated/Private GA only (sales dependency). Hosted gets opt-in beta.

jordan: Implementation plan sketch: quick routing policy layer (low effort) + separate compatibility service that maintains variant capability flags. The compat service is the risky piece and should be a 1-sprint spike then follow-on.

maria: Edge cases to capture in PRD: 
- model variant missing custom tokenizer or having different tokenization semantics
- model truncation differences due to tokenizer mismatch
- KV cache incompatibility when re-attaching a session to a different model
- mid-stream fallback causing client re-attach errors or duplicate tokens
- function-calling contract break (args schema changes or handler mismatch)

nina: Commercial note: Customer A will only sign if regional_affinity SLA is explicit. Mark as sales-priority and block GA until contract alignment.

alex: Proposed prioritization: (1) regional_affinity GA for Dedicated/Private, (2) compat matrix & validation tooling, (3) cost_first fallback as opt-in beta, (4) UX for tenant controls.

sam: Action items: @alex update PRD with acceptance criteria and SLO numbers by Thu EOD; @jordan run tech spike for compat service (1 week); @maria produce test matrix for function-call + streaming edge cases; @nina surface Customer A timeline and escalation.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled for 2024-05-09 09:00 UTC — "Routing PRD update due" :bell:

alex: Will update and ping for review. :thumbsup:
